intersection.headline: New Balance becomes the Dallas Mavericks' official footwear and apparel partner in a multi-year deal
intersection.summary: This is the brand's first whole-team NBA deal. It builds on its sponsorship of rookie-of-the-year Cooper Flagg, who has been with New Balance since his Duke days. The deal covers co-branded merchandise, in-arena activations and community programmes, and was launched with a two-day fan activation outside the arena. Financial terms were not disclosed, and a Flagg signature shoe is expected but undated.

sports.headline: Skydance's Ellison weighs which sports rights to keep after $110bn WBD takeover
sports.summary: After closing its Warner Bros. Discovery deal, Skydance holds rights to nearly every major US league except the NBA. It also carries roughly $80bn of debt. David Ellison told analysts he is reviewing the CBS Sports and TNT Sports portfolio but gave no detail on what might be sold. Sportico's coverage of the earnings call is dated 9 November.

sports.headline: NWSL announces 2026 awards finalists, with Temwa Chawinga and Trinity Rodman among the MVP contenders
sports.summary: The league named its finalists on 9 November and opened a fan-voting round. Votes close on 11 November. Winners will be revealed on ESPN2 on 18 November, ahead of the 21 November championship. Just Women's Sports leads on Chawinga and Rodman.

sports.headline: Montreal MLS club enlists banks to launch sale process
sports.summary: The club is one of three MLS teams whose value fell in Sportico's 2026 valuations. Its value dropped 4% to $430m. The move signals pressure on some MLS franchises as the league heads into its 'MLS 3.0' reset.

fashion.headline: Jason Rabin leads management buyout of Centric Brands, with MSP Sports Capital among the backers
fashion.summary: WWD reports that Rabin takes a majority stake alongside Axar Capital, M-Cor Capital and MSP Sports Capital. The company licenses apparel across fashion and sports. It supplies the NBA and NHL and sells to Amazon and arenas, and the investors say its sports side is still growing.

fashion.headline: Max Mara Fashion Group quietly launches new contemporary label M-M For Mondays and More
fashion.summary: The Italian group has added an 11th brand to a portfolio that includes Sportmax, Max&Co. and Pennyblack. The label is built around an everyday wardrobe and the ideas of minimalism, movement and modularity.

marketing.headline: American Express names Jess Ling chief marketing officer
marketing.summary: Ling, currently EVP of global brand advertising, takes the role on 30 November. She follows Elizabeth Rutledge, who retires in March and will work with her through the handover. Ling has been at Amex since 2019 and helped build its in-house creative agency, OnBrand.

marketing.headline: Ad Age top 5 creative campaigns: Tesco, Xbox, Amazon and more
marketing.summary: Ad Age's weekly creative round-up picks two retailer Christmas spots about journeys home. It adds a remembrance campaign, a hand-painted car ad and a video game console ad. It is useful analysis of current campaigns.

marketing.headline: ChatGPT is about to show brands how often users mention them
marketing.summary: Digiday reports that OpenAI is preparing a first-party dashboard for brand mentions. It would sit alongside third-party tools such as Profound and Adthena, which sell estimates of brand visibility in ChatGPT. The dashboard is still in beta and lacks the prompt and competitor data those vendors offer.
